basic_details.job_title: ESIC Mulund Recruitment 2026 – Walkin for Senior Resident, Part Time Specialist and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Maharashtra Employees State Insurance Society Hospital, Mulund (ESIC Mulund) is recruiting candidates for 9 vacancies across Senior Resident - Orthopedics, Contractual Part Time Specialist - Pediatrics and Medical Officer posts on a contract basis. Eligible candidates can attend a walk-in interview on 21 October 2026, with reporting scheduled at 11:00 AM. Aspiring candidates should fill up the form attached along with advertisement before coming to walk in interview at the venue specified in the official notification. The notified pay is Rs. 1,27,141 Per Month for Senior Resident - Orthopedics

age_limit.details: The upper age limit varies by post: | Senior Resident - Orthopedics: Upper age limit is 45 years as on date of interview. Contractual Part Time Specialist - Pediatrics: Up to 69 years as on the date of interview. Medical Officer: Up to 69 years as on the date of interview.

post_wise_qualification.essential_qualification: MBBS and MS Orthopedics. Registered with MMC with valid renewal

MBBS with P.G./DNB Degree from recognized university with post PG experience of 3 years OR PG Diploma from recognized university, having Post PG experience of five (5) year respectively in particular specialty

qualification.details: Senior Resident - Orthopedics: MBBS and MS Orthopedics. Registered with MMC with valid renewal | Contractual Part Time Specialist - Pediatrics: MBBS with P.G./DNB Degree from recognized university with post PG experience of 3 years OR PG Diploma from recognized university, having Post PG experience of five (5) year respectively in particular specialty | Medical Officer: MBBS Degree from recognized university

important_instructions: Reservation for various categories will be awarded as per GOM Rules. If a candidate of the respective category is not available, the post will be filled in by candidate of any other category in the merit list. Candidates should also be in possession of the certificates in the prescribed format in support of their claim. Candidates claiming reservation under OBC category should submit the latest Non-Creamy layer Certificate along with self declaration. Medical Superintendent may increase, decrease or cancel filling up of any or all the post without assigning any reasons. Recruitments are purely on contractual/temporary basis and selected candidate will have no claim for regularization of the service in the hospital. Selected candidate will have to sign agreement of term and condition on Rs. 500 stamp paper to be purchased by candidate prior to joining. The appointee shall not be entitled to any benefit like provident fund, pension, gratuity, medical attendance treatment, seniority, promotion, leave encashment etc. or any other benefits available to the ESI doctors appointed on regular basis. No TA/DA will be admissible for walk in interview or joining the post. Selected candidate must have a professional indemnity policy which should cover the period of contract. Professional Indemnity Policy sum assured of minimum Rs. 20 lacs (Twenty Lacs) for all surgeons and Rs. 10 lacs (Ten Lacs) for all non-surgeons. A copy of the insurance and premium receipt must be submitted within 7 days from the date of joining.

faq.question: Q1. When is the ESIC Mulund walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held on 21 October 2026 from 11:00 AM to 1:00 PM.

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting venue for the interview?
faq.answer: The venue is the Office of the Medical Superintendent, Maharashtra Employees State Insurance Society Hospital, Mulund (W) Mumbai-400080.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 9 vacancies available across Senior Resident, Contractual Part Time Specialist, and Medical Officer posts.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for Senior Resident - Orthopedics?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS and MS in Orthopedics and must be registered with MMC with a valid renewal.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for Medical Officer posts?
faq.answer: The upper age limit for Medical Officer is up to 69 years as on the date of interview.

faq.question: Q6. What is the monthly salary for Senior Resident - Orthopedics?
faq.answer: The notified salary for Senior Resident - Orthopedics is Rs. 1,27,141/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. Are these posts permanent?
faq.answer: No, the recruitments are purely on a contractual or temporary basis, and selected candidates will have no claim for regularization.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for attending the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee, and no TA/DA is admissible for attending the interview.
